instructions: Which action should the character in a top-down game perform in response to the player's command?

actions.move_up: Move up, toward the top of the screen
actions.move_down: Move down, toward the bottom of the screen
actions.move_left: Move left, toward the left side of the screen
actions.move_right: Move right, toward the right side of the screen
actions.turn_left: Turn in place to face left (counterclockwise) without moving
actions.turn_right: Turn in place to face right (clockwise) without moving
actions.attack: Attack, hit, strike, or charge at an enemy
actions.defend: Block or guard against an attack
actions.roll: Roll or dodge out of the way of an incoming attack
